subject: SIG questionnaire: control mappings & telemetry samples
messages:
From: Alice Monroe <alice.monroe@fintechco.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: FinTechCo Security Team <security@fintechco.com>
Date: Wed, 20 Oct 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG request and telemetry sample window

Hi Priyom,

Thanks for the intro last week. Procurement and InfoSec asked me to open a formal SIG/data-flow request so we can close our review: they need a completed SIG questionnaire (we can start with a partial upload) and a 72-hour production telemetry sample (logs + request traces) to validate routing and key provenance.

Key asks and deadlines:
- Completed SIG questionnaire (partial accepted): requested by Oct 29 (procurement gate)
- Telemetry sample: 72-hour window (UTC) and a short readme describing fields, anonymization applied, and retention stamps
- Control-to-evidence mapping: for SOC 2 and ISO controls called out in section B of the attached PDF

We attached FinTechCo_SIG_Request.pdf with our template. Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide a telemetry sample with logs redacted for PII and a control mapping CSV? Also let us know if a BAA or additional DPA is required before the telemetry sample is shared.

Appreciate a short mutual action plan so we can sync workstreams on our end.

Best,
Alice Monroe
Security Programs Manager
FinTechCo
[Attachment: FinTechCo_SIG_Request.pdf (pdf, 320KB)]

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Alice Monroe <alice.monroe@fintechco.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 21 Oct 2027 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG request and telemetry sample window

Alice — thanks for the clear ask and the template. We can absolutely support this. I outlined a proposed mutual action plan below and attached a preliminary control map and telemetry-sharing instructions.

Proposed MAP (high level):
1) Today (Oct 21): We confirm scope and who owns each artifact (this email thread).
2) By Oct 23: Redwood delivers an initial control-to-evidence CSV (attached) and telemetry sample instructions (how we redact, which fields we will omit).
3) By Oct 25: We push a gated telemetry sample (redacted) to a secure Drive link and hand off SOC 2 report excerpts and key KMS proof.
4) By Oct 29: Final SIG questionnaire upload to your intake portal.

Attached: redwood_control_map_v1.csv and telemetry_sample_instructions.pdf. Notes: the telemetry sample will be redacted for PII by default; however we need to align on which token/trace ids we can leave intact to validate request flows. If FinTechCo requires additional legal paperwork (BAA/DPA) prior to telemetry, flag it here and we will loop Legal.

Internal owners (cc'd): Laura — SOC 2 excerpts and SOC auditor contact; Ben — telemetry pull and redaction; I will coordinate KMS/key provenance evidence with Neha.

If that MAP looks good I will start the artifact pull.

--
Priyom Das
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.com
[Attachments: redwood_control_map_v1.csv (csv, 45KB); telemetry_sample_instructions.pdf (pdf, 80KB)]

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 22 Oct 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: INTERNAL: FinTechCo SIG - artifact sprint and owners

Team — tracking thread for FinTechCo (DEAL-2027-0987). Alice asked for a 72-hour telemetry sample and a control-evidence crosswalk. Timeline above. Please ack and commit to the tasks below by EOD today.

Task list:
- Ben (telemetry): Pull a 72-hour sample from our prod ingestion (UTC window: 2027-10-15 00:00 to 2027-10-17 23:59). Apply standard redaction (PII hash + remove IPs), produce a readme that maps fields to schema. Deliverable: telemetry_sample_20271015-17.zip (S3) and telemetry_sample_readme.md. Due: Oct 24 EOD.
- Laura (assurance): Provide SOC 2 report excerpt for CC3 and the ISO 27001 scope statement. Also include auditor contact and time-bound assurance statements. Deliverable: SOC2_excerpts.pdf. Due: Oct 24 EOD.
- Neha (crypto/KMS): Provide key provenance proof and a short note on key custodianship, rotation cadence, and HSM integration. Deliverable: kms_proof_bundle.zip. Due: Oct 24 EOD.

Risks/notes: If procurement insists on raw identifiers (they typically won't), Legal will need to triage. Ben, flag any retention constraints if pulling older logs will require approvals.

Thanks — Priyom

HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/DEAL-2027-0987
